source: User follow-up in this coordinator chat
instruction: make sure development process chaff is cleaned up in the release, but it can stay in the work branch

development_process_cleanup.choice: Remove development process chaff from release; retain it on work
development_process_cleanup.meaning: Audit repository-wide docs, comments, tests, scripts, templates and generated copies in the release candidate. Remove temporary process narratives, ledgers, continuation prompts, probes, switches, stale references and generated copies. Preserve durable product semantics, necessary licensing/provenance and meaningful test fixtures. No deletion from work required.
